thread:
Aaron (Support): FYI customer ACME reports Dedicated capacity console shows 0 nodes for cluster rename. Ticket #ACME-987. Screenshot: https://redwood.screens/abc :frowning: Please triage — high priority.

Mike (SRE): which cluster name? original and new?

Aaron (Support): Old: eu-west-2-prod, New: eu-prod-2. Dashboard path: Console > Dedicated > eu-prod-2 > Nodes. Usage graphs still show GPU tokens consumed but node list empty.

Sara (Oncall): taking. pinging infra. @Jen can you check inventory-service and eventbus around 2024-12-01 10:12?

Jen (Infra): looking. Reconciliation job logs show many 'skip event: cluster_id mismatch' from 10:12:05. snippet:
```
2024-12-01T10:12:05Z INFO reconcile event=TopologyChange cluster_id=eu-west-2-prod -> eu-prod-2 filtered=true reason=cluster_blacklist
```
It seems rename emitted event with old id in header, our filter expects exact cluster_id.

deploy-bot: Deployed inventory-service v3.4.1 to prod at 2024-12-01T09:50Z

Mike (SRE): can you run a quick DB check? `SELECT count(*) FROM nodes WHERE cluster_name='eu-prod-2';`

Jen (Infra): result: 0 rows. `SELECT count(*) FROM nodes WHERE cluster_name='eu-west-2-prod';` -> 8 rows.

Mike (SRE): That explains it. UI pulls by cluster_name; rename updated label on nodes, but inventory index still points to old name.

Jen (Infra): Looks like the rename updated k8s labels but we missed writing a cluster alias mapping in inventory-index. Quick workaround: create admin mapping so eu-prod-2 maps to eu-west-2-prod. Running:
```
POST /admin/cluster-aliases
{"canonical":"eu-west-2-prod","aliases":["eu-prod-2"]}
```
Applied.

Aaron (Support): Customer confirmed nodes reappeared in console, latency dashboards still OK. Customer notified.

Sara (Oncall): remediate: 1) backfill index for rename events (Jen) 2) add e2e test for cluster rename (Mike) 3) incident postmortem + customer note (Aaron). Assigning owners.

Jen (Infra): I'll open PR to fix event filter + backfill script. ETA EOD. Will also run manual reindex for ACME.

Mike (SRE): Verified UI now shows 8 nodes. Will monitor telemetry. :thumbsup:

Aaron (Support): Closing support ticket once postmortem done. Thanks all.

deploy-bot: Created incident DL: INC-20241201-17 and linked ticket ACME-987.

Sara (Oncall): Followups: ensure deploy gating for inventory-service includes migration check. I'll add to oncall checklist.
